snippet.title: Elon Just Described the Megapod on a SpaceX Earnings Call
snippet.description:
Master Plan: What Elon Musk is Actually Building book: https://a.co/d/04C1qu8Z
Abundance or Collapse book: https://a.co/d/0cQgFdGH

On the SpaceX Q3 2026 earnings call, Elon described modular inference compute built at the factory, with the power and cooling built in, then shipped all over the country, if not all over the world. That is the same idea as Tesla's Megapod trademark: a complete AI computer in a crate, with chips, power and cooling in one box.

Elon says the limit on AI right now is power and cooling more than chips. SpaceX has a plan for 20 GW of new power next year if everything goes right (a SpaceX target, not a result; roughly 10 Hoover Dams of capacity by my math). And Tesla already builds power and cooling in a box at scale: Megapack.

Full Megapod breakdown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mr3Z0hNoK2s

Labels: the 20 GW figure is a SpaceX target stated on the call. Megapod is a Tesla trademark filing (USPTO serial 99893717); no product, price or spec has been announced, so the crate in this Short is a concept drawing.

snippet.title: I Found a Cheat Code for Making Sushi 🍣
snippet.description:
Apparently, there’s no such thing as too much filling in my sushi rolls 😂🍣

I had some really good sashimi-quality fish at home, and since my husband loves sushi, I decided to make these extra-thick, futomaki-style rolls!

Futomaki is a Japanese sushi roll known for being thick and packed with fillings, which is exactly how I like mine! 🤭 I love getting all those flavors and textures in one big, satisfying bite.

I loaded these up with otoro, chutoro, salmon, shrimp tempura, avocado, cucumber, and masago. Basically all my favorites in one roll! 🤤

And of course, I brought back my rice paper trick! Making fancy sushi rolls at home can be a lot. Rice on the outside, plastic wrap, keeping everything from falling apart...I‘ve been there 😭

The rice paper holds everything together before wrapping it in gim, making rolling so much easier and less messy. No perfect sushi skills needed!

You can mix and match your favorite fillings, too. If you love sushi but find rolling it intimidating, definitely give this one a try! 🤍

🍣 Loaded Sashimi Roll (Futomaki-Style)

Makes 3 rolls

- Sushi Rice

snippet.title: Dev Kayayı Evin Temeline Dönüştürdüler🏗️
snippet.description:
Bu arazinin tam ortasında devasa bir kaya vardı 

ve onu kırıp kaldırmak çok pahalıya mal olacaktı.

Bu yüzden ekip kayayı yok etmek yerine evin temelinin bir parçası olarak kullanmaya karar verdi.

Önce kayanın sağlamlığını kontrol ettiler, 

ardından içine delikler açıp çelik bağlantılar yerleştirdiler.

Daha sonra evin ana kolonlarını bu bağlantılara sabitleyip kirişleri ve zeminleri yerleştirerek evi kat kat inşa ettiler.

Ancak yağmur suyunun kayanın üzerinden eve doğru akmasını önlemek için alt kısımlara özel bir drenaj sistemi kurdular.

İnşaat tamamlanınca havuzu yaptılar, 

bahçeyi düzenleyip dışarıya taş yollar, açık hava mutfağı ve otopark bile eklediler.

Son olarak kayanın doğal şeklini koruyarak temizlediler ve evin tasarımına dahil ettiler.

Böylece devasa bir kayayı kaldırmanın masrafından kurtulupevin temelini destekleyen bir parçaya dönüştürdüler.
